plan: Drive: from Village of Burns Lake, about 102 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Tibbets Creek Rd, Hwy 16, Hwy 35, Brown Rd.
Park: 53.50037, -125.1855, where the truck road ends (Natalkuz-500 Road FSR); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.3 km on 6500 by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 320 m SW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-4, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
